title: sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.152.0
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs and bump SDK versions to v1.152.0. This PR consolidates several language-specific fixes and parity adjustments so downstream teams have consistent behavior for automatic auth refresh, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming API edge-cases.

Changes include: consolidated retry policy semantics (max_attempts, jitter, idempotency hints), standardized auth token refresh hook (sync/async/streaming-aware), streaming reconnect/backpressure fixes (resume token handling and graceful EOF), ergonomics improvements to top-level constructors (fewer required params, clearer defaults), and version bumps for python/ts/go packages.

Checklist:
- [x] Update SDK auth adapters and expose unified refresh callback
- [x] Ensure retry semantics parity across languages with test matrix
- [x] Fix streaming EOF/reconnect edge-case (resume tokens preserved)
- [x] Update docs and changelogs for each SDK package
- [x] Run integration tests against hosted sandbox and Dedicated smoke tests

Compatibility notes: default retry/backoff values changed to be more conservative (fewer retries for non-idempotent calls). Existing clients relying on previous aggressive retry behavior should pin older SDK versions until they opt-in. No wire-protocol changes.

Rollout plan: merge to main, publish SDK packages behind feature gates for 24h, enable by default after a canary window and automated error-rate monitoring. Rollback: revert the release branch and rev-publish prior package versions.
